youtube_title: La Porte's weather anomaly: the Indiana town scientists studied
body: La Porte's weather was once so strange, scientists studied it ⛈️ This week: mostly dry and near 70 right up to Halloween, with nights around 50. But for decades in the mid-1900s, La Porte got more rain, thunderstorms and hail than the towns around it. Follow for the daily forecast and more La Porte weather history: laporteweathernow.com #LaPorte #Indiana #Weather #History #MichiganCity #NWIndiana

youtube_title: The newspaper ad that lured men to Belle Gunness's farm (Part 3)
body: Part 3: The newspaper ad 🕯️ "Triflers need not apply." Belle Gunness advertised as a comely widow with a large farm in La Porte County. Andrew Helgelien, a South Dakota farmer, answered it, and in January 1908 he came to La Porte with nearly $3,000. Follow for Part 4: the clue that didn't fit. #BelleGunness #LaPorte #Indiana #History #TrueStory #Halloween

youtube_title: Belle Gunness: the clue that didn't fit (Part 4)
body: Part 4: Was the woman in the fire really Belle Gunness? 🔥 A doctor who knew her said the body was shorter and far lighter: "It is not that of Mrs. Gunness." Her dentist and the coroner said it was her. Follow for Part 5: the woman arrested in Los Angeles in 1931. #BelleGunness #LaPorte #Indiana #History #Mystery #Halloween

youtube_title: Frankenstein, Dracula and the Year Without a Summer
body: Frankenstein and Dracula trace back to the same rainy summer, and it started with a volcano 🌋⚡ Mount Tambora erupted in 1815, 1816 became the Year Without a Summer, and a ghost-story contest on Lake Geneva gave us Frankenstein and The Vampyre. Follow for La Porte's own Halloween stories. They're just as strange. #Halloween #Frankenstein #Dracula #History #LaPorte #Indiana

youtube_title: Was Belle Gunness still alive in 1931? (Part 5)
body: Part 5: Was Belle Gunness still alive in 1931? 🕯️ In Los Angeles, a housekeeper named Esther Carlson was charged with poisoning the 81-year-old man she worked for. She died of tuberculosis before her trial. Two people from La Porte viewed her body and swore it was Belle, and her trunk held a photo of three children said to be Belle's. No one ever proved it. Do you think Belle got away with it? #BelleGunness #LaPorte #Indiana #History #Mystery #Halloween
